saving.label: Saving…
saving.failedTitle: This change was not saved on this device
saving.failedBody: It is on the screen but not stored, so it will be gone if you reload. Try again, and check that this browser is allowed to store data for this site.
saving.deviceTitle: This device is not saving changes
saving.deviceBody: The last change was not stored, so it will be gone when you reload. Check that this browser is allowed to store data for this site.

unreadable.title: The saved records could not be read
unreadable.body: WorkAxis keeps this demonstration's records in this browser, and this time it could not read them back. Nothing has been changed or lost — the records are still there and nothing new will be written over them until they can be read.
unreadable.persists: If this keeps happening, open Settings: it says whether this browser is storing anything at all.

error.title: This screen did not load
error.body: Nothing was changed. Try again, and if it keeps failing, reload the page.

noResults.title: No matches
noResults.body: No records match the current search and filters.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The address you opened does not exist in WorkAxis.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: What needs attention across every site today.
dashboard.emptyTitle: Nothing to show for this site
dashboard.emptyBody: Every total on this screen is counted from the records in this browser, so an empty screen means an empty site.
dashboard.point1: Open, overdue and critical work orders, each a link into the queue
dashboard.point2: Spare parts below their minimum, and inspections still to run
dashboard.point3: A needs-attention list ordered by how late the work is

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.emptyBody: Every asset and every work order hangs off a location, so the location tree is built first.
facilities.point1: Five laboratory sites across provinces, each with buildings, floors and rooms
facilities.point2: The assets held in any location, one click from the location

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: The equipment register: what it is, where it is, how critical it is.
assets.emptyBody: The register is the backbone of the system: work orders, plans, inspections and documents all attach to an asset.
assets.point1: Tag, type, location, criticality and status for every piece of equipment
assets.point2: Full history per asset: work done, parts used, inspections passed
assets.point3: A printable QR label so a technician can open the asset by scanning it

workOrders.title: Work orders
workOrders.description: Corrective and preventive work, from request to completion.
workOrders.emptyBody: A work order carries the whole job: the asset, who is doing it, the tasks, the parts and the record of what happened.
workOrders.point1: A queue filtered by status, priority, site and assignee
workOrders.point2: Fixed status steps with a reason required before anything is cancelled
workOrders.point3: Task checklists, parts used and a time-stamped history

preventiveMaintenance.title: Preventive maintenance
preventiveMaintenance.description: Recurring plans that raise work before something fails.
preventiveMaintenance.emptyBody: Plans turn a schedule into work orders automatically, which is how compliance dates get met.
preventiveMaintenance.point1: Plans by asset or asset type, with the tasks each visit requires
preventiveMaintenance.point2: Frequency by calendar or by meter reading
preventiveMaintenance.point3: A forward schedule showing what is due, by site and by week

inspections.title: Inspections
inspections.description: Templates, completed inspections and the findings they raise.
inspections.emptyBody: An inspection is a fixed set of questions with a recorded answer for each, which is what makes the result auditable.
inspections.point1: Reusable templates with pass, fail and measured-value questions
inspections.point2: Completed inspections with who did them and when
inspections.point3: Findings that become work orders without being retyped

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Spare parts, stock levels and what was issued to which job.
inventory.emptyBody: Stock only means something next to a minimum, so parts arrive with their reorder point.
inventory.point1: Stock on hand against the minimum, per storeroom
inventory.point2: Parts issued to a work order, deducted from stock
inventory.point3: A transaction trail for every receipt, issue and adjustment

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Manuals, certificates and drawings, attached where they are needed.
documents.emptyBody: A document is only useful next to the asset or the site it belongs to, so documents are filed against records rather than in folders.
documents.point1: Manuals, calibration certificates and drawings per asset and per site
documents.point2: Version and expiry, so an out-of-date certificate is visible
documents.point3: Download from the asset, the work order or the inspection

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Operational reporting on work, compliance and stock.
reports.emptyBody: Reports read the same records as the screens, so a number in a report can always be traced back to the work orders behind it.
reports.point1: Backlog, completion time and overdue work by site
reports.point2: Inspection compliance against what was scheduled
reports.point3: Export to CSV and print, in English or French

users.title: Users and roles
users.description: Who uses WorkAxis and what each role may do.
users.emptyBody: Roles are the security model: every screen and every action asks the role first.
users.point1: Demo users across the six roles, each assigned to sites
users.point2: A plain-language list of what each role may and may not do
users.point3: Role changes take effect immediately, with an audit entry

waitingToSend.title: Waiting to send
waitingToSend.description: Changes saved on this device that the server has not been told about yet.
waitingToSend.emptyBody: Nothing on this device is waiting for the server.
waitingToSend.point1: What each change will do, in the order it will be sent
waitingToSend.point2: Whether it was made while offline
waitingToSend.point3: What happened to the last change that was sent

settings.title: Settings
settings.emptyTitle: The rest of settings arrives with the screens it describes
settings.emptyBody: Resetting the demonstration works now, above. The remaining settings describe the organization and its vocabulary, so they land with the screens that read them.
settings.point1: Default language and time zone for the organization
settings.point2: Vocabulary lists such as asset types and failure causes, in both languages
settings.point3: Work-order numbering and the default due date

myWork.title: My work today
myWork.description: The work assigned to you, one job at a time.
myWork.emptyBody: Work assigned to you appears here as cards you can open with one thumb.
myWork.point1: Today's assigned work, most urgent first
myWork.point2: One work order at a time: tasks, parts, photos
myWork.point3: Keeps working without a signal, and sends when the connection returns

myNotifications.title: My notifications
myNotifications.description: What you hear about, and how. Your own choices, not the organization's.
myNotifications.emptyBody: The alerts you can turn on and off appear here once the records have been read.
myNotifications.point1: Choose which alerts reach you in the app
myNotifications.point2: Choose which of them would also be emailed
myNotifications.point3: An auditor sees the choices and cannot change them

floorMap.unrecordedTitle: Nobody has looked for a drawing of this floor

floorMap.unreadableMarkerBody: The position is on file and the machine it points at is not. That is not an empty space on the floor: it is a marker nobody can read, and it is shown as one rather than as a floor with nothing on it.
floorMap.unplacedTitle: On this floor, not on the plan
floorMap.unplacedBody: No position has been recorded for these, so the drawing cannot show where they stand. They are listed because a machine the plan cannot draw is still a machine on the floor.
floorMap.missingBody: Nothing in WorkAxis is filed under {identifier}. Floors are addressed by their code, as it reads on the plan: MCT-B01-F1.

floorMap.lowPartsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No spare below its minimum} one {# spare below its minimum} other {# spares below their minimum}}
floorMap.onPhoneTitle: The plan is shown from tablet width up
floorMap.onPhoneBody: A floor plan on a phone is smaller than the machines drawn on it. The rooms below hold everything the plan does, and each machine opens from there.
floorMap.noPlansTitle: No floor has a plan on file yet
floorMap.noPlansBody: A floor appears here once a drawing is filed against it. The places below are the whole estate either way.

about.inspections: How many inspections passed. Work not yet done sits outside the rate rather than counting as a failure.
